replaced_by.2341:1677: Slow delivers Slowed 1 (Fort) at R3 with multi target at R6, outperforming heightened Agitate for action denial.
replaced_by.1451:1555: Heroism at R3+ gives more bonuses and heightens for a single target. Bless doesn't heighten, but covers more party members.
replaced_by.1457:1530: Fireball at R3 delivers equal damage (6d6) in a 20-ft burst vs Breathe Fire's 15-ft cone. Better area, same scaling.
replaced_by.1457:1329: Cave Fangs at R3 delivers 6d6 piercing in a 20-ft burst with difficult terrain, vs Breathe Fire's 15-ft cone fire. Better area and terrain control.
replaced_by.1329:1559: Howling Blizzard at R5 delivers stronger AoE burst damage (Reflex) in the Primal tradition.
replaced_by.1462:1508: Eclipse Burst delivers stronger burst damage at R7+ with mental+fire damage and a Blinded rider on crit fail.
replaced_by.1466:1661: Scouting Eye at R5 provides mobile scrying — you can move the sensor, unlike Clairvoyance's fixed point.
replaced_by.1503:1665: Sending at R5 provides instant cross-planar communication vs Dream Message's overnight delay.
replaced_by.1524:665: For single targets, Agonizing Despair is stronger at R3+. But, Fear becomes multi-target at R3 (doesn't scale beyond R3).
replaced_by.1530:1462: Chain Lightning at R6 deals 8d12 electricity to chained targets — higher average damage than heightened Fireball with flexible multi-target selection.
replaced_by.1533:1350: Cinder Swarm at R4+ scales better for sustained fire damage and adds Dazzled/Blinded riders (Fort).
replaced_by.1559:1508: Eclipse Burst delivers stronger burst damage at R7+ with a Blinded rider on crit fail.
replaced_by.1677:1981: Containment at R4+ offers Reflex-targeting action denial for a single target. Slow becomes multitarget at R6. Consider both for Fort/Will and ST/Multi defense targeting variety.
replaced_by.1724:1720: Teleport provides superior range at R6+.
replaced_by.1742:2449: Missed Cue (Rare) is a stronger Will-targeting blast at R6+, adding Slowed alongside Frightened.

replaces.1677:2341: Upgrade from Agitate — native Slow outperforms heightened Agitate for action denial. Great at R6 for Multi targeting.
replaces.1555:1451: Upgrade from Bless — broader status bonus package for a single target (+1 to attacks, Perception, saves, skills).
replaces.1530:1457: Upgrade from Breathe Fire — 20-ft burst replaces 15-ft cone at equal damage and scaling.
replaces.1329:1457: Upgrade from Breathe Fire — 20-ft burst with difficult terrain replaces 15-ft cone at equal damage scaling.
replaces.1559:1329: Upgrade from Cave Fangs — stronger AoE burst in the Primal tradition.
replaces.1462:1530: Upgrade from Fireball — higher damage ceiling (8d12) with chain targeting instead of a fixed burst area.
replaces.1661:1466: Upgrade from Clairvoyance — mobile scrying sensor.
replaces.1665:1503: Upgrade from Dream Message — instant communication, no overnight delay.
replaces.665:1524: Upgrade from Fear for single targets and adds heightening damage to the debuff — but consider Fear at R6 for Multi target.
replaces.1508:1462: Upgrade from Chain Lightning — mental+fire damage with Blinded rider on crit fail.
replaces.1508:1559: Upgrade from Howling Blizzard — stronger burst damage with Blinded rider.
replaces.1350:1533: Upgrade from Floating Flame — better sustained damage scaling with Dazzled/Blinded riders.
replaces.1981:1677: Upgrade from Slow — Reflex-targeting action denial. But consider Slow at R6 for Multi targeting.
replaces.1720:1724: Upgrade from Translocate — removes range limitations for long-distance travel.
replaces.2449:1742: Upgrade from Vision of Death — stronger Will blast, adds Slowed to Frightened.

editorial_observations.name: Horizon Thunder Sphere
editorial_observations.observation: Both R1 electricity spells. HTS deals more raw damage but requires an attack roll; Thunderstrike uses a Reflex save. Choose based on your accuracy vs reliability preference.

editorial_observations.name: Revealing Light
editorial_observations.observation: Both R2 Dazzled delivery, but Revealing Light doesn't scale (keep in low rank to reveal invisible enemies). Ignite Fireworks adds scaling & persistent damage at the expense of duration & not revealing invisible enemies.
